search_term.description: The value to search for (name, tag, layer name, component type, or path)

page_size.description: Number of results per page (default: 50, max: 500)

action.description: Action to perform: add (add component), remove (remove component), set_property (set component property)

target.description: Target GameObject - instance ID (preferred) or name/path

search_method.description: How to find the target GameObject

property.description: Property name to set (for set_property action)

value.description: Value to set (for set_property action). For object references: instance ID (int), asset path (string), or {"guid": "..."} / {"path": "..."}. For Sprite sub-assets: {"guid": "...", "spriteName": "<name>"} or {"guid": "...", "fileID": <id>}. Single-sprite textures auto-resolve.

properties.description: Dictionary of property names to values. Example: {"mass": 5.0, "useGravity": false}

component_index.description: Zero-based index to select which component when multiple of the same type exist. Use the components resource to discover indices. If omitted, targets the first instance.

action.description: Perform CRUD operations on Unity scenes and control the Scene View camera.

Get and update the Unity Editor state. deploy_package copies the configured MCPForUnity source into the project's package location (triggers recompile). restore_package reverts the last deployment from backup. undo/redo perform editor undo/redo. For prefab editing (open/save/close prefab stage), use manage_prefabs.
